title: TopologyNode
description: An aggregated pipeline-stage node in the live topology graph. Identity is (jobId, nodeKind), see ARCHITECTURE.md §7.1.

nodeCategory.description: Drives which icon (§ icon set) and default layout position the UI uses

icon.description: Icon key matching docs/assets/icons/*.svg or otter-control-plane-ui equivalent, e.g. 'apachekafka', 'redis', 'onnx'. Null falls back to nodeCategory's default icon.

activeModelVersions.description: Non-empty only for inference nodes; more than one entry means a canary is active
